children: Faeth appointed Karen Vousden, Ph.D. as a Class II director and added her to the Compensation Committee, effective September 11, 2026.
Class II Director; Member, Compensation Committee
Board increased size from five to six directors and appointed Dr. Vousden

Cancer biologist; co‑founder of Faeth (Apr 2019); Principal Group Leader, Francis Crick Institute since Feb 2017; former Chief Scientist, Cancer Research UK (2016–2022); former director, Beatson Institute (2002–2016); board member, Bristol Myers Squibb since 2018; Ph.D. in genetics
Appointed to Compensation Committee, effective immediately
